title: Elder twist
description: One elder's rule twist (P5, Y2, Y3) in data/twists/<id>.json. It belongs to the elder a map node names (the node's 'yokai' with 'elder': true), not to a fighter's kit or behaviour profile, so it holds for whichever fighter stands in for that elder. 'effect' is one of a closed list of sim rules the fight applies to the elder's fighter; the text the player reads (HUD label, intro card, first-meeting callout) is story text, referenced by key or story-card id.

elder.description: The yokai id elder map nodes name (Y2). One twist per elder.

effect.description: The sim rule (closed list). reflect_repeated_special: a special the opponent starts that is the same special as the one it started just before (the repeat-th use in a row or later) is reflected when it would connect. special_armour: the elder's specials take up to 'hits' hits each from frame 1 to their last active frame without being interrupted (the damage lands). unbreakable_throws: the opponent's throw-break press (C4, E12) does nothing against the elder's throws.

repeat.description: From which use in a row the special is reflected (2 = the second).

hits.description: Hits each special takes without being interrupted.

label_key.description: Key of the one-line HUD reminder (text: habit-writer).

icon.description: Map-node icon id (Y3); the UI picks the glyph.

intro_card.description: data/story/<id>.json: the one-line intro card (Y3). Optional until the text is written.

callout_card.description: data/story/<id>.json: the first-meeting callout (Y3). Optional until the text is written.
